result: acted: ESCALATED TO THE OWNER (once per 24h, spent this cycle). The Mac lane tick has not fired since 2026-09-15T04:57:20.368Z — 3.35 hours, over the three-hour threshold this routine committed to in PR #771. The escalation is NOT the launchd reinstall that was queued: the root cause is in the checkout log of every Mac job since, quoted verbatim — `/usr/bin/git version` answers "You have not agreed to the Xcode license agreements", so actions/checkout finds no usable git and falls back to "The repository will be downloaded using the GitHub REST API", leaving a workspace with no .git at all. fetch-depth: 0 cannot help a workspace that has no clone. That is why proof:sim-requests then reports all 17 sim-result provenance commits as "does not resolve" — it asked git in a directory with no git history — and the job named "full-clone provenance" ran with no clone. OWNER ACTION, one command with admin rights at the Mac keyboard: the licence-accept command Xcode's own error names (xcodebuild -license accept, run as root); then bash scripts/mac/install-launchd.sh --status to confirm the tick resumed. FALSIFIED THE OTHER DIRECTION before escalating: nothing but heartbeat files has landed on mainline since the last green Mac run (git log --since=2026-09-15T00:00:00Z --name-only origin/SignalGrid_Alpha, minus artifacts/agent-heartbeats, is empty), so the tree the Mac was asked to verify is the same tree that passed at 00:38:41Z; the difference is the machine. BLAST RADIUS: three commits across two PRs failed identically (#772 f9fbec11 and f05deed8, #744 a01c9a5c), and check-merge-authorization refuses any PR carrying a red check — verified on #772, REFUSED — so while the Mac is down the lane cannot self-merge anything at all, docs included. Lane-mail PRs are the exception, exempt by mac-runner-auto.yml paths-ignore, which is how this heartbeat lands. The 08:00 nightly Mac run had not fired as of 08:18. ALSO THIS CYCLE: #764 closed as superseded (it carried the 00:25Z heartbeat; that file is single-state and mainline holds 06:26Z); #744 unstuck from dirty by keeping both 2026-09-14 intake rows, preflight PASSED with 320 gates ok on the merged tree, now green except the Mac check and owner-gated on scripts/; #771 merged as 82bd3243; #772 opened, then corrected — its BUILD_BACKLOG row was a re-raise of a Pages item org-roster.json has owned since 2026-08-25 and explicitly says not to re-raise, so the row was reverted in full and the one new fact (the legacy Jekyll builder now fails on every push, so mainline build reads red, and that failure is currently the only thing keeping a render of the whole repo off the live domain) was appended to the item that already owns it. Mainline 82bd3243; two lane messages unread, both addressed to mac, consistent with the Mac being down; sim-request loop passes locally, 17/17; live-evidence 2.22 days (under 3d).
